summary: Frontend-only iteration 13: verified refactor of /map top-bar and new refresh/availability FABs for Ana. All 6 test blocks pass. Header (top-bar) no longer shows the group name (only user Ana + bar-status with location='Sin ubicación' + battery% + notifications badge). Group name 'Grupo 1' is shown ONLY in groups-bar/group-chip below. fab-refresh initially shows '10s'; opening refresh-panel and tapping refresh-30 updates the pill to '30s'; setting persists across full page reload (AsyncStorage). fab-availability opens availability-panel with toggle-pause and toggle-schedule; enabling schedule shows HourStepper sched-from/sched-to with -plus/-minus; enabling pause displays the red 'Ahora mismo NO compartes tu ubicación.' warning. Regression clean: fab-recenter, fab-layers→layers-panel→layer-pharmacy, fab-sos→sos-panel, member-rect→member-tools-sheet, group-chip taps navigate to /group/{id}. No red screens, no critical console errors (401s belong to unauthenticated /permissions polling before token was ready and self-resolve). Native-only expectations (avatar 3D anchor / ~6-block zoom) intentionally NOT verified per request. Minor RN deprecation warnings detected: shadow* props and pointerEvents prop (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple styles use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g. /app/frontend/app/map.tsx:473,482,483,485,486,491,493,498). Consider migrating to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/RNW compatibility.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/map.tsx:213,265,271 (pointerEvents={hidden ? 'none' : 'box-none'} on Animated.View).

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style keys to boxShadow across map.tsx and other components to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (cosmetic).
Optional: move pointerEvents from prop to style on Animated.View instances (map.tsx L213/265/271).
critical_code_review_comments: map.tsx is 500 lines — approaching split threshold. Consider extracting RefreshPanel, AvailabilityPanel and HourStepper into /src/components to keep the screen focused.

storage.setItem calls in setRefresh/togglePause/toggleSched/setFrom/setTo are fire-and-forget (no await/catch). If storage fails silently the UI still updates. Acceptable for AsyncStorage but consider a debug log on rejection.
withinSchedule uses hourNow from `new Date().getHours()` computed once per render — will not react to hour crossing while panel is open. Low priority.
